PORT.description: Port Railway routes to - leave as is

LAMINAR_USERNAME.description: Username for the dashboard's login prompt

LAMINAR_PASSWORD.description: Auto-generated password for the dashboard's login prompt

APP_SERVER_HOST.description: App server on the private network (receives /v1/* SDK and OTLP traffic)

PORT.description: Port the dashboard listens on - leave as is

HOSTNAME.description: Listen on IPv6 and IPv4 so Railway's private network can reach it

ENVIRONMENT.description: Self-hosted mode without RabbitMQ; also runs the Postgres and ClickHouse migrations on boot

BACKEND_URL.description: App server HTTP API on the private network

BACKEND_RT_URL.description: App server realtime (live trace updates) on the private network

NEXTAUTH_URL.description: Public URL of the dashboard - set it to your custom domain after adding one

NEXT_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public URL of the dashboard - keep equal to NEXTAUTH_URL

PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL.description: API URL shown in the dashboard (dataset downloads)

NEXTAUTH_SECRET.description: Auto-generated secret that signs sessions and invitation links

AEAD_SECRET_KEY.description: Auto-generated 32-byte key (64 hex characters) that encrypts stored provider API keys - never change it after the first boot

CLICKHOUSE_URL.description: ClickHouse HTTP interface on the private network

CLICKHOUSE_RO_USER.description: User for the SQL editor's queries (same user, as in upstream's compose)

CLICKHOUSE_RO_PASSWORD.description: Password for the SQL editor's user

RAILWAY_HEALTHCHECK_TIMEOUT_SEC.description: The first boot runs 70+ ClickHouse migrations (about 5 minutes in testing) before the health check can pass

LLM_PROVIDER.description: Optional: openai, gemini, bedrock, azure_chat_completions, ... for the AI features (chat with a trace, SQL with AI)

PORT.description: HTTP API port (SDK, OTLP/HTTP, dashboard backend) - leave as is

CLICKHOUSE_URL.description: ClickHouse HTTP interface on the private network

CLICKHOUSE_RO_USER.description: User for the SQL editor's queries (same user, as in upstream's compose)

CLICKHOUSE_RO_PASSWORD.description: Password for the SQL editor's user

AEAD_SECRET_KEY.description: Same encryption key as the dashboard

NEXT_INTERNAL_URL.description: Dashboard on the private network; CLI tokens are verified against its keys (unset, the app server would trust laminar.sh's keys)

QUICKWIT_ENABLED.description: Full-text search needs Quickwit, which this template leaves out (see README)

RAILWAY_HEALTHCHECK_TIMEOUT_SEC.description: Time for the app server to connect to its databases

PGDATA.description: Data subdirectory - keeps Postgres happy on Railway volumes

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Time for Postgres to shut down cleanly on redeploy

deploy.startCommand: /bin/sh -c 'printf "<clickhouse><profiles><default><date_time_input_format>best_effort</date_time_input_format></default></profiles></clickhouse>" > /etc/clickhouse-server/users.d/laminar.xml && R=; for t in trace_log text_log part_log metric_log asynchronous_metric_log background_schedule_pool_log query_metric_log query_thread_log query_views_log session_log crash_log opentelemetry_span_log zookeeper_log blob_storage_log processors_profile_log asynchronous_insert_log error_log latency_log; do R="$R<$t remove=\"1\"/>"; done && printf "<clickhouse><logger><level>warning</level><console>1</console><size>10M</size><count>1</count></logger>%s<query_log><ttl>event_date + INTERVAL 3 DAY DELETE</ttl></query_log></clickhouse>" "$R" > /etc/clickhouse-server/config.d/laminar.xml && exec /entrypoint.sh'

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Time for ClickHouse to flush and shut down cleanly on redeploy

MALLOC_CONF.description: Keeps jemalloc off transparent huge pages; without it idle ClickHouse memory creeps up on Railway
